tagline: Edoardo Bove is releasing a documentary tracing his on-pitch cardiac arrest and his return to football with Watford.
synopsis: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?
